title: Paired Countdown · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Paired Countdown · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and agree on a starting number between five and ten. The pair takes turns saying the next number down, one number per person. They reach zero in the correct order without skipping a number. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Paired Countdown, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
They reach zero in the correct order without skipping a number.
recall.why: They reach zero in the correct order without skipping a number.
